name: Hash City
intro: Every citizen here is a profile of fields.
A hash is a small file about one thing.
Welcome to Hash City. Name, then fields.

1: Each building holds many labeled slots.
The city files things under a name.
2: A hash stores fields under one key.
You set a field on a hash.
You read a field from a hash.

ok: A field locks into the profile.
error: That field does not fit this file.
No such field on that profile.

curiosity: What else lives in that profile?
One field at a time, a whole person appears.
I wonder what HP it has now.
humor: One key, many hats. That is a hash.
This city files everything. Even feelings.
A citizen is just a key with good fields.
wisdom: A hash keeps one thing's many parts together.
Update one field without losing the rest.
Profiles are power. Read them all.
sternness: HSET needs a field and a value.
One field per call. No skipping.
The file is only as good as its fields.
